# Keep the fixture-global prefix scoped to extension browser tests

The changed extension compose attachment family uses gAccount for its reusable host test account while nested extension callbacks use account parameters. Follow the established g prefix for shared host fixtures in this family when it improves role separation. Do not infer a repository-wide global naming rule: this batch also has tabmail, prefsWindow and testFolder globals without g. browser_ext_ filenames preserve API spellings such as cloudFile and messageDisplay, then use underscore-separated scenario suffixes.

Scope: Extension browser fixture and file naming.
